findings.highlight: The heat in my body has gone away somewhat
findings.evidenceJa: 体の熱も下がっている
findings.governingReading: my temperature has also gone down
findings.explanation: A reduced fever is presented as heat having disappeared.

findings.highlight: The wound has turned dark blue
findings.evidenceJa: むき出しの肌、傷痕は青黒く変色していた
findings.governingReading: on the exposed skin, the scar had discolored blue-black
findings.explanation: The English omits the exposed skin and turns the scar into the wound itself.

findings.highlight: I can see fresh red meat
findings.evidenceJa: 赤黒い肉が覗いている
findings.explanation: The wound’s dark, damaged flesh becomes generic fresh red meat.

findings.highlight: so it won’t get any worse
findings.evidenceJa: 左腕を動かすだけで傷口が広がってしまう
findings.governingReading: otherwise merely moving my left arm will spread the wound open
findings.explanation: A concrete mechanical danger is weakened into generic worsening.

findings.highlight: there is frost on the grass outside
findings.evidenceJa: 庭にはまだ霜が残っている
findings.governingReading: frost still remains in the garden
findings.explanation: The location is changed from the garden to unspecified grass outside.

findings.highlight: I choose the one that looks like it is the best
findings.evidenceJa: 一番魔力の通りがよさそうな物を選び
findings.governingReading: I choose the one that seems to conduct magical energy best
findings.explanation: The technical criterion for choosing the wooden sword disappears.

findings.highlight: to reassure myself that I won’t be coming back here
findings.evidenceJa: 戻ってはこれないと覚悟したつもりなのか
findings.governingReading: to steel myself for the possibility that I will not return
findings.explanation: A grim act of resolve is mislabeled as emotional reassurance.
